messages:
Maya (Finance): FYI - AtlasNova invoice INV-2026-1147 is 45 days past due. ACH returned this morning and they just emailed asking for a split-payment plan. Sharing details below.
BillingBot: Automated notification: ACH return for INV-2026-1147 (R01 - insufficient funds). Original due date: 2026-03-15. Invoice total: $45,000. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1147
Tony (Account Exec): On it — I spoke with their CFO yesterday. Cashflow tight due to delayed funding. They requested a 3-installment schedule, preferred start next week. Wants to avoid service interruption because they're mid-onboarding.
Jess (Collections): We can consider a plan but need conditions: signed payment schedule, autopay enabled, and clear consequences for missed installments. Also request waiver/adjustment of late fees?
Tony (Account Exec): Customer asked to waive the $1,200 late fee if we accept the split and keep service live. They said they'd sign an addendum.
Carl (Finance Director): We can approve a one-time split up to 90 days but require guarantee: autopay + card on file or ACH + first payment up front. If first payment doesn't clear by the agreed date, services go on credit hold.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare our standard payment-plan addendum (short form) and include language for autopay, default remedies, and confidentiality. Send me the proposed schedule.
Jess (Collections): Proposed schedule (from Tony/client):
```
Invoice: INV-2026-1147  Amount: $45,000
1) $15,000 due 2026-05-08
2) $15,000 due 2026-06-08
3) $15,000 due 2026-07-08
Late fee $1,200 -> customer requests waiver if 1st payment clears by 2026-05-08
```
Jess (Collections): Also recommend we hold waiving the fee until payment clears. Will need AM or Finance sign-off to waive.
Maya (Finance): Can we make the waiver conditional (clear first payment by 5/8)? If so I can approve the ledger adjustment after clear. We also need to update AR aging bucket + set a monitoring flag.
Carl (Finance Director): Conditional waiver OK: waive $1,200 only if first installment clears on or before 2026-05-08 and autopay is enabled. Add a clause: missed payment triggers immediate service suspension and late fee reinstatement.
Tony (Account Exec): Customer agreed to autopay and will provide card on file. I'll confirm during the scheduled call. Please queue the addendum.
Legal Ops: Drafted the addendum and uploaded to the shared drive, sending link in DM. I'll include the suspension/reinstatement language and require sign by CFO.
Jess (Collections): I'll prepare the outbound email with the payment link and the addendum attached. Plan to send after Tony confirms card on file. Scheduling a call Thurs 10:00am PT with the customer to finalize.
BillingBot: Note: last ACH attempt returned code R01. Recommend manual retry after first installment authorization.
Maya (Finance): Thanks — please CC finance when you send. Once payment clears, I'll mark invoice as on-payment-plan and stop ongoing dunning messages.
Tony (Account Exec): Will do. Quick ask: product ops — can we avoid suspending onboarding infra during this process? It's critical for churn risk.
Jess (Collections): We can pause suspension while the first payment is pending (until 5/8) given the conditional waiver, but if payment fails we enforce hold same day. Adding that to the outbound email.
Carl (Finance Director): Approved conditional plan and waiver. Finance will re-evaluate if customer misses installment 1.
Maya (Finance): Great — I will update the AR notes and expected cashflow. Follow up here after the 5/8 attempt.
Tony (Account Exec): I'll post meeting notes and the signed addendum after the call. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
